fusions.name: Scent Cloud
fusions.desc: Looses a cone 4 tiles ahead that deals 4 damage to everything in it, each with a 30% chance of [Marked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Last Mile
fusions.desc: A finishing blow that deals 22 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Locked On
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 15 seconds. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Fed at the Finish
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
